description: This script generates benchmark visualization figures comparing different agent frameworks, including AgentField SDKs and external frameworks, based on JSON benchmark results.

methods.name: load_results
methods.description: Loads benchmark results from JSON files in a specified directory.

methods.name: get_metric
methods.description: Extracts a specific metric value from the loaded results.

methods.name: create_benchmark_figure
methods.description: Creates and saves a visualization figure comparing framework metrics.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to load results and generate the benchmark visualization.
